campaign_name: Email campaign targeting organizations in Canada to deliver Lumma Stealer
targeting_evidence: The report explicitly states the campaign was 'targeting organizations in Canada' and that 'emails' subject line were personalized to include recipient-specific details such as 'Invoice for [recipient email]'.
channels: Email > Prometheus TDS (Compromised website) > ClickFix landing page > Windows Run prompt (mshta/PowerShell)
tactics: Other (specify) - ClickFix / Fake CAPTCHA (Social engineering payload execution)

roles.role_impersonated: Fitness plan provider (The Fitness Ladder) / Online education platform

request: Click a link to cancel a subscription, then solve a fake CAPTCHA (ClickFix) by pasting a malicious command into the Windows Run prompt.
pretext: The recipent's free trial for a fitness plan (e.g., The Fitness Ladder) is ending shortly and they will be automatically billed for a premium subscription ($19.99/mouth) unless they take action to cancel.
